tools.name: AddDut
tools.description: Create a DUT (Struct / Enum / Union / Alias) in <Plc> Project^DUTs, write its declaration (TYPE ... END_TYPE from Fields / AliasType; an Enum without Fields gets enum_member := 0) and read it back. Fields is an ARRAY in declaration order (#47): Struct / Union [{"name":"bStart","type":"BOOL"},{"name":"nCount","type":"INT","init":"0","comment":"..."}], Enum [{"name":"eIdle","value":0},{"name":"eRun","value":1}]; the old object form {"bStart":"BOOL"} is not accepted (INVALID_PARAMS: object key order is not kept). An invalid entry (name not an identifier, duplicate name, missing type, unknown key) -> INVALID_PARAMS, nothing created. After saving, the declaration read back is parsed and its member order compared with the input: a difference -> MEMBER_ORDER_MISMATCH (data.expectedOrder, data.actualOrder, data.declaration; the DUT exists, fix it with WritePouCode), never success; on success data.memberOrder is the order read back. data: path, objectKind (DUT), itemType (605 Enum / 606 Struct / 607 Union / 623 Alias), declaration, memberOrder. A name that already exists or a declaration that reads back different -> DUT_CREATE_FAILED. Change it later with WritePouCode Declaration only (a DUT has no implementation). BUILD_REQUIRED (#65): a created DUT (also one whose readback failed) records kind code-changed for the open solution (data.buildRequired names the tool and the DUT; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written): EnableConfig / PlcLogin / SendPlcProgram then refuse with BUILD_REQUIRED until BuildProject returns data.completeBuild=true. Project file (#76): CreateChild changes the .plcproj only in XAE memory, so after the readback the project files are saved (DTE Project.Save of the .tsproj, with a deadline: PROJECT_SAVE_TIMEOUT + data.saveDiagnostics) and the .plcproj is read back from disk: success only when it has a <Compile Include> with the relative path of the object <folders>\<Name>.TcDUT (data.projectSaved: plc, plcproj, tsproj, savedFiles, verifiedFiles [file, preExisting], plcprojChanged, lastWriteBefore, lastWriteAfter, saveSec, warning); otherwise PROJECT_SAVE_FAILED (data.objectPath, createdInMemory=true, savedToDisk=false: the object exists only in XAE memory; error.hint gives the next step, also when the .plcproj cannot be located) or IDE_MODAL_DIALOG. What else Project.Save writes (measured 2026-10-28, 4026 VS2022): a dirty plain text document is NOT saved; whether unsaved content of a PLC editor (a POU edited in the GUI) is written was NOT verified. PLC still logged in (XAE: Cannot add an object because it affects a device you are currently logged into, measured 2026-10-29 4026 VS2022) -> PLC_LOGGED_IN, nothing created and no BUILD_REQUIRED recorded: PlcLogout first, then call it again.

tools.name: AddInterface
tools.description: Create an INTERFACE (CreateChild 618, TE1000 v1.7.0 6.5.5) in <Plc> Project^POUs (or PlcProjectPath) and read it back: the declaration must be INTERFACE <Name> (EXTENDS <Extends> when given). Extends is one string (an array is refused by XAE, measured 2026-10-31 4026 VS2022); not an identifier list -> INVALID_PARAMS. Same checks, BUILD_REQUIRED (#65), project file save (#76, .TcIO in the .plcproj) and PLC_LOGGED_IN as AddPou; failure codes POU_CREATE_FAILED (step in the message), PROJECT_SAVE_FAILED / PROJECT_SAVE_TIMEOUT, IDE_MODAL_DIALOG. data: path, folderPath, objectKind (ITF), itemType 618, extends, declaration, projectSaved. Add methods / properties with AddPouMember ParentPath=<data.path>.

Extends.description: Optional interface it extends, as one string (e.g. I_Base; several: 'I_A, I_B' is passed as given, not measured). Must be identifiers separated by commas.

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path of the folder the interface is created in, e.g. TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs (same as AddPou PlcProjectPath). Omit to auto-detect (<Plc> Project^POUs, else the <Plc> Project node; see data.folderPath).

tools.name: AddLibrary
tools.description: Add a library reference to the PLC project: ITcPlcLibraryManager.AddLibrary(Name, Version, Vendor) on TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^References (TE1000 6.5.14). Version * = newest installed (.plcproj gets LibraryReference Include="<name>,newest,<vendor>"). Already referenced (also as placeholder #<name>): success with data.alreadyPresent=true, nothing added, no BUILD_REQUIRED. Not installed: LIBRARY_ADD_FAILED with data.notInstalled=true and an install hint; nothing is saved, the .plcproj is unchanged. Several PLC projects: pass PlcProjectPath (else PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS). BUILD_REQUIRED (#65): the added reference (also when AddLibrary failed for another reason) records kind code-changed for the open solution (data.buildRequired names the tool and the library; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written): EnableConfig / PlcLogin / SendPlcProgram then refuse with BUILD_REQUIRED until BuildProject returns data.completeBuild=true. Project file (#76): the reference is stored in the .plcproj, which is saved (DTE Project.Save of the .tsproj, deadline: PROJECT_SAVE_TIMEOUT) and read back from disk: success only when it lists a library reference named Name (data.projectSaved); otherwise PROJECT_SAVE_FAILED or IDE_MODAL_DIALOG. What else Project.Save writes (measured 2026-10-28, 4026 VS2022): a dirty plain text document is NOT saved; whether unsaved content of a PLC editor (a POU edited in the GUI) is written was NOT verified.

Version.description: Library version. Default '*' = newest installed (the manual sample uses '*'; the project file then gets <LibraryReference Include="<name>,newest,<vendor>">, measured).

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name (FrameworkUnitTest) or tree path (TIPC^FrameworkUnitTest^FrameworkUnitTest Project). Required when the solution has more than one PLC project.

tools.name: AddPlaceholder
tools.description: Adds a library placeholder to the PLC project (ITcPlcLibraryManager.AddPlaceholder), saves the project file and reads it back.

Placeholder.description: Placeholder name, with or without the leading '#'.

LibraryName.description: Default library of the placeholder (e.g. Tc2_Math). Empty: one-argument form (device placeholder).

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

tools.name: AddPou
tools.description: Create a POU (Program, FunctionBlock or Function, language ST) in <Plc> Project^POUs (or PlcProjectPath) and read it back: success only when the new item is found with the expected kind. data: path, folderPath, objectKind (POU), itemType (602 Program / 603 Function / 604 FunctionBlock), language (read back from the new item, must be ST), declaration (default header written by XAE; a Function header must contain : ReturnType). Then fill it with WritePouCode. What else Project.Save writes (measured 2026-10-28, 4026 VS2022): a dirty plain text document is NOT saved; whether unsaved content of a PLC editor (a POU edited in the GUI) is written was NOT verified. Type.description: POU type: Program, FunctionBlock, or Function.

ReturnType.description: Return type for Functions (e.g., INT, BOOL). Ignored for Program/FunctionBlock.

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path of the folder the POU is created in, e.g. TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs (same on 4024 and 4026). Omit to auto-detect (<Plc> Project^POUs, else the <Plc> Project node; see data.folderPath).

tools.name: AddPouMember
tools.description: Add a Method, Property, Action, or a property Get / Set accessor below a PROGRAM / FUNCTION_BLOCK / INTERFACE (Get / Set: below a property) and read it back (CreateChild, TE1000 v1.7.0 6.5.5). ParentPath: full tree path (TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs^FB_Motor; for Get / Set ...^FB_Motor^P_Speed) or a name as for GetPouCode (FB_Motor, FB_Motor.P_Speed). Sub type / vInfo (measured 2026-10-31 4026 VS2022, self-built client): FB / PROGRAM parent Method 609 {language, ReturnType, Access}, Property 611 {language, ReturnType, Access}, Action 608 {language}; INTERFACE parent Method 610 {ReturnType}, Property 612 {ReturnType}; property parent Get 613 / Set 614 {language, Access}. ReturnType is required for a Property, optional for a Method, not allowed for Action / Get / Set; Name is not needed for Get / Set. Access PUBLIC / PRIVATE / PROTECTED / INTERNAL is checked by the module (XAE makes any other value PUBLIC silently) -> POU_MEMBER_INVALID; wrong parent kind, Access / Language on an interface member -> POU_MEMBER_INVALID. Get / Set below an INTERFACE property (654 / 655) -> POU_MEMBER_UNSUPPORTED (reading such an accessor crashed VS2022); Get / Set with Access other than PUBLIC or Language other than ST -> POU_MEMBER_UNSUPPORTED (accessor-not-measured); a Method without ReturnType only with PUBLIC + ST (its language is reported, not checked). Same name below the parent (case-insensitive) -> POU_MEMBER_EXISTS (data.existingPath). Ambiguous parent name -> POU_AMBIGUOUS (data.candidates). Modal dialog -> IDE_MODAL_DIALOG, PLC logged in -> PLC_LOGGED_IN (PlcLogout first); nothing created in these cases. Success only after the new item is found with the expected ItemType and its declaration names the member, access and type (an action has none; method / action language checked). data.path = full tree path of the member: pass it as PouPath to GetPouCode / WritePouCode. A property gets no Get / Set by itself: add them with Kind Get / Set. Failure after CreateChild -> POU_MEMBER_CREATE_FAILED naming the step (the member stays in the tree). BUILD_REQUIRED (#65): a created member records kind code-changed (data.buildRequired). No project file save is needed (the parent .TcPOU is written at once, the .plcproj does not change).

ParentPath.description: The POU, interface or property that gets the member: a full tree path (TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs^FB_Motor, ...^FB_Motor^P_Speed for Get / Set) or a name as for Get-TcPouCode -PouName (FB_Motor, FB_Motor.P_Speed). A name several objects carry returns POU_AMBIGUOUS with data.candidates.

Kind.description: Method, Property, Action, Get or Set.

Name.description: Member name (IEC identifier). Not needed for Get / Set: an accessor is always named Get / Set.

ReturnType.description: Method: return type (optional; none = a method without return type). Property: its type (required). Not allowed for Action / Get / Set.

Access.description: PUBLIC (default), PRIVATE, PROTECTED or INTERNAL (TE1000 6.5.5 p.231). Anything else returns POU_MEMBER_INVALID. Interface members and actions take none; Get / Set only PUBLIC.

Language.description: Implementation language of a method / action / accessor: ST (default), IL, SFC, FBD, CFC or LD.

tools.name: BuildProject
tools.description: Build the PLC project of the open solution and wait for the result. On BUILD_FAILED read data.codeErrors (description/file/line taken from the XAE Error List) instead of guessing. data.errors counts CODE errors only; missing / unresolved libraries (Library Manager rows such as "Could not open library") are counted separately in data.libraryErrors and listed in data.libraryErrorItems. With library errors the PLC code may not have been compiled at all (no code error is then reported), so a build that would otherwise succeed returns LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED (success=false, buildSucceeded=null, codeVerified=false): install the missing libraries in the XAE Library Manager first; AllowUnresolvedLibrary=true accepts it as success with data.warningCode=LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED, but such a build is never complete (data.completeBuild=false) and keeps BUILD_REQUIRED, so EnableConfig / PlcLogin still refuse (#61). data.codeVerified=true means the Error List was read, lists no library error and no code row without a line, and every PLC project took part in the build: a PLC project skipped by the configuration (or none in the solution) gives codeVerified=false and data.warningCodes [PROJECT_SKIPPED_BY_CONFIGURATION, CODE_NOT_VERIFIED] (#58); a success that is not verified that way (Error List unreadable, unlocated code rows) carries data.warningCode=CODE_NOT_VERIFIED. data.warningCodes lists every warning code (data.warningCode is the first). Breaking change (#23): data.errors no longer includes Library Manager rows. data.errorItems keeps every Error List error, each with category code | library | other (other = no file, e.g. a build-summary row). data.decidedBy says what decided buildSucceeded (LastBuildInfo, else ErrorList). Warnings come with their contents: data.warningItems (same shape) and data.codeWarnings (without Library Manager items), unless data.errorListError is set. A full build can take several minutes: the build is started asynchronously and SolutionBuild.BuildState is polled (the synchronous VS2022 call never returns); TimeoutSec (default 600) bounds the wait, after which BUILD_TIMEOUT is returned; a modal dialog that appears during the build is returned as IDE_MODAL_DIALOG. Requires ConnectIde with an open solution. Coverage: data.projects lists every PLC project (.plcproj) with status built / skipped / failed / unknown (from the active solution configuration, DTE SolutionContext.ShouldBuild), data.skippedProjects and data.coverageComplete. data.solutionConfiguration is '<configuration>|<solution platform>' read like GetIdeInfo (data.solutionPlatform equals GetIdeInfo solutionPlatform), data.projectPlatform the .tsproj project platform, data.platformSource how the solution platform was read (with 'context' solutionConfiguration is the configuration name only); each PLC project's own platform is data.projects[].platform. BUILD_REQUIRED (after a platform switch, or after a build that was not a complete success) is cleared only by a build with coverageComplete=true and codeVerified=true (data.completeBuild=true; never an AllowUnresolvedLibrary build, #61). A build that ends LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED, BUILD_FAILED, BUILD_STATUS_UNKNOWN, BUILD_TIMEOUT or IDE_MODAL_DIALOG after it started, or succeeds with completeBuild=false records BUILD_REQUIRED for the solution (data.buildRequired; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written), so EnableConfig and PlcLogin refuse until a complete build (#56; not for a solution without PLC project). With accepted library rows and a code row without a line number data.warningCodes has LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED and CODE_NOT_VERIFIED. A PLC project that the active solution configuration does not build (no Build.0 in the .sln) is skipped silently by XAE while it still says Build succeeded: the result keeps success but sets data.warningCode=PROJECT_SKIPPED_BY_CONFIGURATION and data.warning. ExpectedProject=[names] makes a skipped project a failure (PROJECT_SKIPPED_BY_CONFIGURATION, build not started), an unknown name EXPECTED_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND; use it whenever a specific PLC (e.g. a unit-test PLC) must be compiled.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the build to finish (BuildState = Done); BUILD_TIMEOUT after that. Default 600.

ExpectedProject.description: PLC project name(s) that must be compiled, e.g. ["FrameworkUnitTest"] (the .plcproj file name without extension). Skipped by the active solution configuration -> PROJECT_SKIPPED_BY_CONFIGURATION (build not started); not in the solution -> EXPECTED_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND.

AllowUnresolvedLibrary.description: Accept a build whose Error List shows unresolved libraries as success (data.warningCode=LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED, codeVerified=false) instead of returning LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED. It is not a complete build (data.completeBuild=false): BUILD_REQUIRED stays recorded and EnableConfig / PlcLogin / RunLifecycle still refuse to activate or download it (#61); install the missing libraries for that.

tools.name: CheckAllObjects
tools.description: Checks the syntax of EVERY object of the PLC project (ITcPlcIECProject2.CheckAllObjects), also the ones no build compiles; returns the Error List rows like BuildProject. Generates no code, never changes BUILD_REQUIRED.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

tools.name: CleanProject
tools.description: Clean the open solution (Build > Clean Solution) and wait until SolutionBuild.BuildState is Done (TimeoutSec default 300 -> CLEAN_TIMEOUT). Use instead of touching DTE yourself: issue #18 once hit a null-valued expression on Solution / SolutionBuild right after ConnectIde (cause not confirmed); this tool waits for them and counts the null answers (data.nullReads). A modal dialog returns IDE_MODAL_DIALOG. Readback SolutionBuild.LastBuildInfo: 0 -> success, data.cleanVerified=true; unreadable -> CLEAN_UNVERIFIED (always a failure); > 0 with only unresolved-library Error List rows (<plc>.Library Manager, no line) -> LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED (data.libraryErrorItems; a later BuildProject success may not have compiled the PLC code, #45), or with AllowUnresolvedLibrary=true success with data.warningCode=LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED and cleanVerified=false; any other error -> CLEAN_FAILED (data.errorItems). data: buildState, failedProjects, cleanVerified, cleanSec, nullReads, errorItems.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum time in seconds for the clean (BuildState = Done). Default 300.

AllowUnresolvedLibrary.description: Accept a clean whose only errors are unresolved libraries ('<plc>.Library Manager'): success with data.warningCode = LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED and data.cleanVerified = $false instead of the LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED error. Use only for a project known to miss libraries.

tools.name: ConnectAds
tools.description: Open the ADS connection to the PLC runtime. Leave AmsNetId empty: it is auto-detected from the IDE target and changes per target (local UmRT, remote CX ...), so never hardcode it. Port defaults to 851 (PLC runtime 1). Requires ConnectIde for auto-detection.

AmsNetId.description: Target AmsNetId. Leave empty to auto-detect from the IDE target (recommended; it differs per target).

tools.name: ConnectIde
tools.description: Connect to a running TwinCAT XAE / Visual Studio instance (found through the Running Object Table); only if none is found does it launch a new XAE. SolutionPath is optional and opens that .sln after connecting. Call this before any project, build or runtime tool. Returns ideProcessId, connectSec (total seconds), launchSec (only when a new IDE was launched: seconds until DTE was ready) and, when a solution is open, the detected target AmsNetId. When the IDE that has SolutionPath open is blocked by a modal dialog or busy (its DTE answers RPC_E_CALL_REJECTED or an empty Version), it is recognised without COM and IDE_MODAL_DIALOG (or IDE_BUSY without a dialog) is returned with data.ideProcessId, data.dialog, data.matchedBy and data.attached; no second IDE is launched. matchedBy module-state (the IDE this server was connected to), session-record (an earlier ConnectIde saw this process with this solution) or dialog-path (the dialog names a file in the solution folder) attach that IDE (attached=true): GetIdeModalDialog / ResetSolution work on it right away. window-title (title = solution name only; may be a same-named copy elsewhere) does not attach (attached=false); when that IDE is not yours, LaunchIfBlocked=true ignores it and launches. After the dialog is closed the same ConnectIde call connects to it.

ProgId.description: COM ProgID to connect to / launch. When given, running instances with this ProgID are preferred and only this ProgID is used for launching.

SolutionPath.description: Path to a .sln file. If specified, the IDE will open this solution automatically after connecting (or connect to an instance already running this solution).

NoLaunch.description: If set, do not launch a new IDE instance if none is running.

LaunchIfBlocked.description: With -SolutionPath: ignore a blocked IDE that matches only by window title (matchedBy 'window-title', i.e. a same-named solution that may be someone else's) and go on as if it were not there (launch unless -NoLaunch). A blocked IDE recognised by strong evidence (module-state, session-record, dialog-path) is still reported.

tools.name: ConsumeXml
tools.description: Generic tree tool that CHANGES the configuration: write an XML fragment into one tree item (ITcSmTreeItem.ConsumeXml, TE1000 v1.7.0 5.2.1.1). Prefer a dedicated tool when one exists. DryRun defaults to true: first call it without DryRun and read data.changes (path, current, planned, changed) and data.currentXml; then call again with DryRun=false. The fragment is sent as-is and XAE merges it (fields not in it keep their value; measured 2026-10-30): root <TreeItem>, element paths exactly as in ProduceXml, only the fields to change, e.g. <TreeItem><TaskDef><CycleTime>40000</CycleTime></TaskDef></TreeItem> (CycleTime unit 100 ns). XAE ignores unknown elements silently, so every leaf path must exist in the current XML, else XML_MERGE_FAILED (data.missingPaths, data.reason syntax / root / empty / paths-not-in-current-xml). Refused before sending because the XAE merge is not measured (XML_MERGE_FAILED): attributes-not-supported (only element values, no attributes; data.attributePaths), structure-mismatch (a value on an element that has child elements now, e.g. <TaskDef/> or <TaskDef>123</TaskDef>; data.structurePaths), repeated-count-mismatch (copy every repeated sibling, e.g. all CPU elements, in the current number; data.repeatedCountMismatches), derived-only (only TcModuleInstance Context / ParameterValues would change; data.derivedPaths). Known fields are validated by the module (TaskDef/CycleTime integer > 0, else TREEITEM_INVALID_VALUE). DryRun=false: ProduceXml backup (+ the node disk file such as <task>.TcTTO) to <solution dir>\.tcauto-backup\<yyyyMMdd-HHmmss>\ (data.backupPath, data.backupFiles, data.warnings), IDE_MODAL_DIALOG if a dialog is open (nothing sent), ConsumeXml, read back: every fragment leaf must have the planned value (derived fields excluded, data.mismatches expected / actual) and every other non-derived element / attribute of the whole XML must be unchanged (data.unexpectedChanges path / kind / before / after): data.verified=true, else TREEITEM_VERIFY_FAILED. Below TIPC records BUILD_REQUIRED code-changed.

Path.description: Full tree path of the item to change, e.g. "TIRT^PlcTask". No wildcards.

Xml.description: The fragment: root <TreeItem>, only the elements to change, no attributes.

DryRun.description: Default true: only report the planned change. false: back up, write, read back.

tools.name: CreateChild
tools.description: Generic tree tool that CHANGES the configuration: create a child below Path (ITcSmTreeItem.CreateChild(Name, SubType, Before, VInfo), TE1000 v1.7.0 5.2.1.2). Prefer AddPou / AddDut / AddGvl / AddLibrary / IoScan when they cover the object. SubType / VInfo depend on the parent; only use values documented in TE1000 / InfoSys, e.g. TIRT task SubType 0 = with image, 1 = without image (6.3.1); TIID EtherCAT master 111 (6.6.1). DryRun defaults to true (nothing created; data.plannedPath, data.currentChildren). Checks: parent exists (TREEITEM_NOT_FOUND with nearest parent), no child with Name (TREEITEM_ALREADY_EXISTS), Before is a child (looked up as Path^Before). DryRun=false: backup of the parent ProduceXml (data.backupPath), IDE_MODAL_DIALOG if a dialog is open (nothing created), CreateChild, look up again and re-read the parent ProduceXml (it may only gain entries, ChildCount +1 is expected, data.parentUnchanged) and the child names must be the old ones plus exactly one (data.childrenAfter; skipped with a warning when the list is cut): data.verified=true, data.createdPath / createdName (XAE may rename: data.warnings); refused -> TREEITEM_CREATE_FAILED, not found afterwards or a parent field changed (data.unexpectedChanges) -> TREEITEM_VERIFY_FAILED. Below TIPC records BUILD_REQUIRED code-changed.

Path.description: Full tree path of the PARENT, e.g. "TIRT". No wildcards.

SubType.description: nSubType of CreateChild (default 0). Depends on the parent; see the examples.

Before.description: Optional name of an existing child before which the new one is inserted (bstrBefore).

VInfo.description: Optional vInfo of CreateChild (string or array, depends on the parent), e.g. "BOOL" for a process image variable, or "EK1100-0000-0017" for an EtherCAT box.

DryRun.description: Default true: only report the plan. false: back up the parent, create, read back.

tools.name: DeleteChild
tools.description: Generic tree tool that DELETES configuration: delete the tree item at Path (its parent ITcSmTreeItem.DeleteChild(name), TE1000 v1.7.0 5.2.1.3). Prefer a dedicated tool when one exists. Full path only, no wildcards, not a top-level node (TREEITEM_PATH_INVALID). ConfirmName is required and must equal the item name exactly, else TREEITEM_DELETE_NAME_MISMATCH (data.nodeName) and nothing is deleted. The item must report the parent derived from Path, else TREEITEM_DELETE_FAILED data.reason parent-mismatch (nothing deleted). DryRun defaults to true (nothing deleted; data.nodeName, itemType, childCount, children). DryRun=false: backup first (recursive ProduceXml data.backupPath, disk file data.backupFiles, ExportChild file data.exportPath for ImportChild: .xti, or .zip for every node below TIPC; XAE refuses .xti for a PLC folder, measured 2026-10-30 4026 VS2022 on a PLC folder only, other TIPC nodes not measured, a failed export deletes nothing). A missing <task>.TcTTO is a warning only when a .plcproj / .tsproj references it (a task without a PLC project has none). When the ExportChild backup fails or its file is missing nothing is deleted: TREEITEM_BACKUP_FAILED data.reason export-failed / export-missing; AllowNoExport=true deletes anyway with a warning. IDE_MODAL_DIALOG if a dialog is open. Then DeleteChild, then the path must no longer resolve: data.verified=true, else TREEITEM_VERIFY_FAILED; refused -> TREEITEM_DELETE_FAILED. Below TIPC records BUILD_REQUIRED code-changed.

Path.description: Full tree path of the item to delete, e.g. "TIRT^Task 2". No wildcards.

ConfirmName.description: Must equal the name of the item (the last path segment as XAE reports it), e.g. "Task 2".

DryRun.description: Default true: only report what would be deleted. false: back up, delete, read back.

AllowNoExport.description: true = delete even when the ExportChild backup (.xti, .zip below TIPC) failed or was not written (only the recursive ProduceXml backup remains, ImportChild cannot restore it; data.warnings says so). Default false: TREEITEM_BACKUP_FAILED, nothing deleted.

tools.name: DisconnectAds
tools.description: Close the ADS connection and forget the cached endpoint (disables auto-reconnect).

tools.name: DisconnectIde
tools.description: Release the DTE/COM references held by the bridge. The IDE keeps running unless Quit=true, which closes the solution without saving and quits the IDE (only use on an IDE that ConnectIde launched). With Quit=true a modal dialog is checked first: if one is up nothing is attempted, nothing is released (the connection stays: for kind reload-prompt run ResetSolution, then DisconnectIde Quit=true again) and the result is IDE_QUIT_FAILED (data.dialog {title, text, kind, reloadTarget}, quit=false, disconnected=false); if DTE.Quit fails the result is also IDE_QUIT_FAILED (success=false, data.ideProcessId / quitError; the IDE process still runs). After a failure the IDE pid is kept, so DisconnectIde Quit=true Kill=true can follow directly without ConnectIde. Kill=true (only with Quit=true) kills the IDE process in those two cases, but only when this session launched it (data.ownedBySession, still true after the internal reconnect of ResetSolution), otherwise IDE_NOT_OWNED and nothing is killed; data.killed tells whether it was killed. COM references are always released.

Quit.description: true = also close the solution (without saving) and quit the IDE.

Kill.description: Only with Quit=true: kill the IDE process when it cannot be quit (modal dialog, DTE.Quit failed). Only for an IDE this session launched (data.ownedBySession); any other IDE -> IDE_NOT_OWNED, nothing killed.

tools.name: EnableConfig
tools.description: Activate the configuration on the target without any dialog. Restarts TwinCAT and downloads/starts the PLC program: the machine stops and restarts. Confirm with the user first. With Force=true it runs the whole lifecycle: Config -> Activate -> wait for Run -> PLC Login+Download -> wait for port 851 -> PLC Run, and reports every step in data.steps. NoLogin=true stops after TwinCAT is in Run (no download, no PLC Run). TwinCAT restarts, so call ConnectAds again afterwards (ReadVariable/WriteVariable also auto-reconnect; data.reconnected tells you). Never add sleeps around this call; it polls until the target state is reached. Before Activate the active solution platform is compared with the platform the target reports through TARGETINFO (ADS port 200, IG 0x700; data.platformCheck='target'), else with Platform when given ('parameter'); the solution platform and the project platform of its .tsproj must both match; on a mismatch the solution platform is switched and the project rebuilt (steps platform-fix, platform-fix-build; data.platformFixed=true; not part of TimeoutSec). NoPlatformFix=true returns PLATFORM_MISMATCH instead, before anything is activated. A solution platform with the right name whose .tsproj is built for another project platform makes the switch return PLATFORM_PROJECT_MISMATCH (data.platformMap, data.requestedProjectPlatform; fix the Configuration Manager). A target without TARGETINFO (ADS 0x702, e.g. the UmRT of TwinCAT 3.1.4026.21-22) and no Platform: platformCheck='skipped', data.warning set, Activate runs as before. data always has targetPlatform, targetPlatformSource (adsTargetInfo / unavailable), solutionPlatform, projectPlatform (.tsproj project platform), platformFixed, platformCheck. ACTIVATE_FAILED = ActivateConfiguration() returned but XAE reported failed projects ('Check config failed!'; nothing written to the target), usually because the active solution platform (data.solutionPlatform) differs from the target platform: retry with Platform ('TwinCAT OS (x64)' for a Usermode Runtime / UmRT or TwinCAT/BSD, 'TwinCAT RT (x64)' for a Windows RT target). Multi-PLC: every PLC project (or PlcProjectPath) is logged in and started on its own ADS port (851, 852, ...; data.plcs). After Activate the project _Boot package is compared with the Boot folder of a target on this PC (data.bootPackage, BOOT_PACKAGE_MISMATCH). Step verify reads back port 10000 and every PLC port at the end and checks for a modal dialog: anything not Run is RUNTIME_STATE_MISMATCH (data.finalCheck), never success; failures after Activate carry data.diagnostics (dialog, Error List rows, bootPackage). BUILD_REQUIRED (nothing activated): after a solution platform switch or after a BuildProject that was not a complete success (LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED, BUILD_FAILED, completeBuild=false; #56) there was no complete BuildProject; Activate would compile by itself without anybody checking the result. Also after WritePouCode / AddPou / AddDut / AddGvl / AddLibrary / ResetSolution (or the New-TcProject cmdlet) changed the PLC code or project (kind code-changed, #65; error.hint names the tool and object). After a BuildProject that did not prove the code compiled (codeVerified not true, e.g. unresolved libraries, also AllowUnresolvedLibrary=true) the module records BUILD_REQUIRED and EnableConfig does not activate, download or start until a complete build (#61; EnableConfig has no AllowUnresolvedLibrary): when the build after an automatic platform switch succeeds with data.completeBuild not true, BUILD_REQUIRED is returned before set-config (message names codeVerified / warningCodes); install the missing libraries and run BuildProject until data.completeBuild=true. A solution never built or changed through these tools is not refused (known limit, see docs/troubleshooting.md BUILD_REQUIRED). RUNTIME_CRASHED of the set-config / set-run step (local UmRT process gone) is returned with its code and hint, crash data in data.runtimeCrash.

Force.description: true = full lifecycle without dialogs (Config -> Activate -> Run -> Login/Download -> PLC Run).

NoLogin.description: true = stop after TwinCAT reaches Run; skip PLC login/download/Run.

TimeoutSec.description: Overall time limit for the whole -Force cycle (single deadline). Default 120. The platform-fix / platform-fix-build steps run before the deadline starts.

NoPlatformFix.description: true = do not switch the solution platform; a mismatch with the target (or Platform) platform returns PLATFORM_MISMATCH before anything is activated.

Platform.description: Reference platform used only when the target does not report one through TARGETINFO (ADS 0x702): 'TwinCAT OS (x64)' for a Usermode Runtime / UmRT or TwinCAT/BSD, 'TwinCAT RT (x64)' for a Windows RT target. A platform the target reports wins.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC project(s) to log in and start, by name (["FrameworkUnitTest"]) or tree path. Default: every PLC project of the solution.

ActivateTimeoutSec.description: Deadline in seconds for ActivateConfiguration() (default 180, also bounded by TimeoutSec with Force). On timeout ACTIVATE_TIMEOUT with data.activateDiagnostics (dialog, ideAlive, ideResponding, runtimeAlive, systemState) instead of waiting forever.

tools.name: ExportChild
tools.description: Generic tree tool: export the tree item at Path with its subtree to an .xti file (parent ITcSmTreeItem.ExportChild(name, FilePath), TE1000 v1.7.0 5.2.1.4). Does not change the configuration. A PLC folder below TIPC (ItemType 601) needs a .zip file name: XAE refuses .xti there ("doesn't specify a zip archive", measured 2026-10-30 4026 VS2022 on a PLC folder only; other TIPC nodes not measured and passed to XAE as given), so the module refuses it first (TREEITEM_EXPORT_FAILED data.reason plc-requires-zip, data.itemType, hint with the .zip name). FilePath must be an absolute file path (not a root such as C:\, no < > | " * ?), its folder must exist and the file must not exist (TREEITEM_EXPORT_FAILED, data.reason not-absolute / invalid-path / folder-missing / file-exists). Success only when the file exists and is not empty (data.exported, data.fileSize). Re-import with ImportChild.

Path.description: Full tree path of the item to export, e.g. "TIRT^PlcTask". No wildcards.

FilePath.description: Absolute path of the file to write: .xti, or .zip for a PLC folder below TIPC (measured 2026-10-30 4026 VS2022 on a PLC folder only; other TIPC nodes not measured). Its folder must exist, the file must not.

tools.name: ExportPlcOpen
tools.description: Exports PLC objects (or the whole PLC project) to a PLCopen XML file (PlcOpenExport on '<Plc> Project'); does not change the project. Reads the file back and lists its objects.

Selection.description: Objects or folders relative to '<Plc> Project', one per element, '.' between folder levels; the first level is a folder of the PLC project, e.g. 'AxisInterface.LIB.AxisControl.FB_AxisControl' (the string measured 2026-10-31) or 'POUs.FB_A'. Leading / trailing blanks are trimmed. Empty = the whole PLC project.

FilePath.description: Absolute path of the PLCopen XML file to write (e.g. C:\Temp\export.xml); its folder must exist.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

Overwrite.description: Replace an existing file: it is renamed to '<FilePath>.bak' first and put back when the export fails.

tools.name: FreezePlaceholder
tools.description: Freezes one library placeholder (or all with -All) to its current version (ITcPlcLibraryManager.FreezePlaceholder). Dry-run by default; backs up the .plcproj, reads it back and checks the version did not change.

Placeholder.description: Placeholder to freeze, with or without the leading '#'. Not together with -All.

All.description: Freeze every placeholder (FreezePlaceholder with an empty name). Not together with -Placeholder.

DryRun.description: Default true: only report. false: back up, freeze, save and read back.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

tools.name: GenerateBootProject
tools.description: Generates the local boot project of a PLC (GenerateBootProject($false) on 'TIPC^<Plc>'): writes _Boot\<platform>\Plc\Port_<port>.* of the project, not the target. SAVES the project files. Reads the boot files back.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>' or 'TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

tools.name: GetBuildErrors
tools.description: Read the compiler messages currently shown in the XAE Error List: data.counts {errors, warnings, messages}, data.errors[] and data.warnings[] (IncludeWarnings defaults to true; IncludeWarnings=false skips the warning toggle and saves 1-2 s); IncludeMessages=true adds data.messages[]. Items are {severity, code, description, project, file, line, column}. Counts are read from the summary buttons in English and zh-TW UI (zh-TW VS2022 'shown / total' labels report the total); other UI languages return ERRORLIST_UNAVAILABLE. In VS2022 the Error List scope filter is switched from Current Project / Current Document / Open Documents to Entire Solution before reading (left switched).

IncludeWarnings.description: Default on; -IncludeWarnings:$false skips the warning toggle (saves 1-2 s of UIA). Also reads warning rows (data.warnings, always present when on, possibly empty).

TimeoutSec.description: Hard limit for the UI Automation scan. Default 30.

tools.name: GetIdeInfo
tools.description: Return version, edition, open solution, ITcSysManager availability and the active solution platform / configuration (solutionPlatform, solutionConfiguration; null when unreadable) of the connected IDE. Cheap connectivity check; fails with NOT_CONNECTED before ConnectIde.

tools.name: GetIoTree
tools.description: Reads the current I/O device tree (TIID subtree) and returns as JSON.

tools.name: GetLibraries
tools.description: Lists the library references and placeholders of a PLC project, or with -Repository the libraries installed on this machine.

Repository.description: List the libraries installed on this machine (ScanLibraries) instead of the project references.

Filter.description: Wildcard on the name (-like, case-insensitive), e.g. 'Tc2_*'. References: matches name, placeholderName or libraryName. Default: everything.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS). -Repository needs a PLC project too (the Library Manager lives on its References node).

tools.name: GetPlcState
tools.description: Read the PLC runtime state (Run/Stop/...) on the connected ADS port.

tools.name: GetPouCode
tools.description: Read the source of a PLC object: POU, DUT, GVL, interface, method ... data.objectKind (POU / DUT / GVL / ITF / METHOD / ACTION / PROPERTY_GET / ... / UNKNOWN, from the tree item ItemType; data.itemType, data.itemTypeName), data.pouType (Program / Function / FunctionBlock for a POU, Struct / Enum / Union / Alias for a DUT), data.language (ST / LD / FBD ..., null for DUT / GVL / ITF), data.hasImplementation, data.implementationReadable, data.declaration, data.implementation. hasImplementation=false (DUT, GVL, ITF, property): implementation is null because the object has no implementation part, the whole source is in declaration. A POU returns an implementation string (empty when there is no code; LD / FBD return XAE XML, not ST); implementationReadable=false means it has an implementation part that did not come back as text (implementation null). A COM call that throws, or a declaration that reads null, returns POU_READ_FAILED. Members: PouPath <POU path>^<member> (accessor ^<property>^Get), or PouName Parent.Member (FB_X.M_Run, FB_X.P_Value.Get; tried after the name as given). A name that several objects carry (M_Run in two FBs) -> POU_AMBIGUOUS with data.candidates (full paths), never the first hit. The Get / Set of an INTERFACE property (ItemType 654 / 655) -> POU_MEMBER_UNSUPPORTED, nothing read (reading it crashed VS2022, measured 2026-10-31 4026 VS2022). An ItemType that cannot be read -> POU_READ_FAILED reason itemtype-unreadable (fail-closed).

PouName.description: Name of the POU to read. A member can be named Parent.Member: FB_X.M_Run, FB_X.P_Value.Get (tried only after the name as given found nothing; becomes <FB_X path>^M_Run).

PouPath.description: Full tree path; omit to auto-detect from PouName (POUs folder -> project root -> tree search depth 4 -> Parent.Member, see data.pouPath / data.resolvedBy). Format on 4024 and 4026: TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs^<name>; DUT ...^DUTs^<name>, GVL ...^GVLs^<name>; member ...^<POU>^<member>, accessor ...^<POU>^<property>^Get. Use GetProjectTree with PlcOnly=true to list paths.

tools.name: GetProjectTree
tools.description: Read the project tree. Every node has name, path, type, itemType, subType and children; path can be passed as-is to GetPouCode / WritePouCode PouPath. type is the item kind from ItemType (Project, Folder, FunctionBlock, Function, Program, Dut, Gvl, Task, References ...) or the numeric ItemType when unknown (itemType / subType are also returned as numbers). The PLC node TIPC^<Plc> also lists "<Plc> Project" with its POUs, DUTs and GVLs folders (on 4024 and 4026 the project node is hidden from enumeration and is added by path). Depth (default 4) = levels below each root, enough for TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs^<POU>; a node at the depth limit that still has children comes back with children=[] and truncated=true. PlcOnly=true returns only the TIPC subtree.

Depth.description: Levels below each root node (1-10, default 4). 4 reaches the POUs: TIPC(0)^<Plc>(1)^<Plc> Project(2)^POUs(3)^<POU>(4). Nodes at the limit that have children return truncated=true.

PlcOnly.description: true = return only the TIPC (PLC) subtree.

tools.name: GetSymbols
tools.description: List the PLC symbols of the connected runtime, optionally filtered by a substring (Filter): data is an array (empty when nothing matches) of {path, type, size, comment}, plus enumValues (member name -> value) for enum types; the execution order is in the top-level order field. Use it to find exact variable paths and types before ReadVariable/WriteVariable.

tools.name: GetSystemState
tools.description: Read the TwinCAT system state (Run/Config) of a target over ADS port 10000. AmsNetId defaults to the IDE target (ConnectIde), then the ADS session (ConnectAds), then the local system 127.0.0.1.1.1; data.amsNetId / data.netIdSource tell which one was used. netIdSource=local means you read the local TwinCAT system, which is usually NOT your target.

AmsNetId.description: Target AmsNetId. Leave empty to use the IDE target, then the ADS session, then the local system 127.0.0.1.1.1 (see data.netIdSource).

tools.name: ImportChild
tools.description: Generic tree tool that CHANGES the configuration: import an .xti / XML file as a child of Path (ITcSmTreeItem.ImportChild(FilePath, Before, Reconnect, Name), TE1000 v1.7.0 5.2.1.6; templates 6.3.2). A PLC folder is imported from the .zip file ExportChild wrote (measured 2026-10-30 4026 VS2022 on a PLC folder only; other TIPC nodes not measured). DryRun defaults to true (nothing imported; data.currentChildren, data.fileSize). Checks: FilePath is a valid absolute file path and exists (TREEITEM_IMPORT_FAILED, data.reason not-absolute / invalid-path / file-missing), parent exists, a child named Name does not exist (TREEITEM_ALREADY_EXISTS), Before is a child (looked up as Path^Before). Without Name the name is read from the .xti (data.expectedName; __FILENAME__ = file name without extension; null for a .zip, then data.warnings says no clash check was done) and checked the same way, dry-run included (XAE would rename silently, e.g. Task28 -> Task28_1). DryRun=false: backup of the parent ProduceXml (data.backupPath), IDE_MODAL_DIALOG if a dialog is open (nothing imported), ImportChild, look the imported item up again and re-read the parent ProduceXml (it may only gain entries, ChildCount +1 is expected, data.parentUnchanged) and the child names must be the old ones plus exactly one (data.childrenAfter; skipped with a warning when the list is cut): data.verified=true, data.importedPath / importedName (a name other than Name / expectedName: data.warnings); refused -> TREEITEM_IMPORT_FAILED, not found or a parent field changed (data.unexpectedChanges) -> TREEITEM_VERIFY_FAILED. Below TIPC records BUILD_REQUIRED code-changed.

Path.description: Full tree path of the PARENT, e.g. "TIRT" or "TIID". No wildcards.

FilePath.description: Absolute path of the .xti / XML file to import; .zip for a PLC folder below TIPC (measured 2026-10-30 4026 VS2022 on a PLC folder only; other TIPC nodes not measured).

Before.description: Optional name of an existing child before which the item is inserted (bstrBefore).

Reconnect.description: bReconnect (default true): re-establish existing mapping information.

Name.description: Optional new name of the imported item (bstrName); empty keeps the name from the file (data.expectedName, checked for an existing child).

DryRun.description: Default true: only report the plan. false: back up the parent, import, read back.

tools.name: ImportPlcOpen
tools.description: Imports a PLCopen XML file into the PLC project (PlcOpenImport on '<Plc> Project'). Dry-run by default: lists the objects of the file, the conflicts with the project and what -Option will do with them.

FilePath.description: Absolute path of the PLCopen XML file to import (e.g. written by Export-TcPlcOpen).

Option.description: What happens with an object that already exists: None (default; a conflict fails, nothing is imported), Replace (the existing object is replaced, children the file lacks are deleted; backed up first), Rename (the imported object gets '_1'), Skip (the existing object is kept).

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

DryRun.description: Default true: only parse, compare and report. false: back up (Replace), import, read back.

tools.name: InstallLibrary
tools.description: Installs a .library / .compiled-library file into a library repository of this machine (ITcPlcLibraryManager.InstallLibrary). Dry-run by default; reads back with ScanLibraries.

LibraryPath.description: Absolute path of the .library or .compiled-library file.

DryRun.description: Default true: only check and report. false: install and read back.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (the Library Manager lives on its References node).

tools.name: IoScan
tools.description: Scan the I/O devices of the target (ProduceXml(false) on TIID, TE1000 6.6.2). Requires the target in Config mode, otherwise IO_SCAN_REQUIRES_CONFIG. Default: only returns data.devices, the I/O tree is not changed; Apply=true adds them (CreateChild + AddressInfo + ScanBoxes) and reads them back. No device found: success, devices=[] and data.warning.

Apply.description: Add the found devices to the I/O tree (CreateChild + AddressInfo + ScanBoxes) and read them back.

tools.name: LinkProgramToTask
tools.description: Links a PROGRAM to a PLC task (CreateChild 650 below '<Plc> Project^<PlcTask>'). Checks first that the name is an existing PROGRAM, exactly; dry-run by default; backs up the task's .TcTTO and reads back.

ProgramName.description: Name of the PROGRAM, exactly as declared (e.g. MAIN).

PlcTask.description: Name of the PLC task below '<Plc> Project' (default PlcTask).

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

DryRun.description: Default true: only check and report the plan. false: back up, create, read back.

tools.name: LookupTreeItem
tools.description: Generic tree tool, read-only: look up ONE tree item by its full path (ITcSysManager.LookupTreeItem, TE1000 v1.7.0 5.1.1.3) and return name, itemType, subType, subTypeName, type, childCount and children[] (name, path, itemType, subType, type). Path is the full tree path separated by ^, e.g. TIRT^PlcTask, TIPC^MyPlc^MyPlc Project^POUs, TIID^Device 1 (EtherCAT); wildcards * ? return TREEITEM_PATH_INVALID. A missing path returns TREEITEM_NOT_FOUND whose error.hint and data.nearestPath / nearestChildren name the nearest existing parent and its children. Prefer GetProjectTree / GetIoTree / GetPouCode when they cover the node.

Path.description: Full tree path, e.g. "TIRT^PlcTask" or "TIPC^MyPlc^MyPlc Project^POUs". No wildcards.

MaxChildren.description: Maximum number of children listed (1-1000, default 200).

tools.name: NewTestCase
tools.description: Build a test case object for RunTest/RunTestCycle. Setup/Teardown are arrays of {Path, Value} writes; Assertions are {Path, Operator, Expected} with Operator one of Equal (default), NotEqual, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, Contains, IsTrue, IsFalse. WaitUntil (preferred) = array of {Path, Operator, Expected} polled until all hold (WaitTimeoutMs, default 5000); on timeout RunTest reports Fail with waitTimedOut, lastValues, waitMs. WaitMs is a deprecated fixed blind wait. Pure data, no IDE/PLC access. Without WaitUntil the result has waitMs and a warning that WaitMs is deprecated (RunTest / RunTestCycle results carry it too); with WaitUntil there is no waitMs (an explicit WaitMs is reported as waitMsIgnored + warning).

Setup.description: Writes before the test: array of {"Path":"MAIN.x","Value":1} (keys Path = PLC symbol path, Value = value to write, converted to the PLC type).

Teardown.description: Writes after the test (also run when the test fails): array of {"Path":"MAIN.x","Value":0} (keys Path, Value).

WaitUntil.description: Conditions to poll before the assertions (replaces WaitMs): array of {"Path":"MAIN.bDone","Operator":"IsTrue"} (same keys and Operator set as Assertions; Expected omitted for IsTrue/IsFalse). All conditions must hold in the same 100 ms sampling round; assertions then run immediately. Not met within WaitTimeoutMs: the test case is Fail with waitTimedOut=true, lastValues, waitMs. Invalid entries: INVALID_PARAMS.

WaitTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in ms to poll WaitUntil (1..600000, default 5000). Only used with WaitUntil.

WaitMs.description: DEPRECATED: fixed blind wait in ms before the assertions (default 1000), ignored when WaitUntil is given. Use WaitUntil.

Assertions.description: Checks after WaitUntil (or the deprecated WaitMs): array of {"Path":"MAIN.y","Operator":"Equal","Expected":1}. Keys: Path (PLC symbol path), Operator (optional, default Equal; one of Equal, NotEqual, GreaterThan, LessThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, LessThanOrEqual, Contains, IsTrue, IsFalse), Expected (omit for IsTrue/IsFalse). Short forms like "eq"/"gt" are NOT accepted.

tools.name: OpenProject
tools.description: Open a solution (.sln) in the connected IDE and wait until the TwinCAT project is loaded.

tools.name: PlcLogin
tools.description: Login to the PLC project and download the program in one call (PLC_LOGIN_FLAGS Regular, prompts answered by SilentMode, no dialogs). Use after a successful BuildProject when TwinCAT is already in Run; EnableConfig Force=true already includes this step. With several PLC projects pass PlcProjectPath (PLC name such as FrameworkUnitTest or tree path); without it PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS is returned instead of logging into the first PLC. data.adsPort is the PLC's ADS port. Refused with BUILD_REQUIRED (every LoginMode, nothing sent to the IDE) while the solution needs a complete BuildProject (after a platform switch, a build that was not a complete success, #56, or a code / project change by WritePouCode, AddPou, AddDut, AddGvl, AddLibrary or ResetSolution (or the New-TcProject cmdlet), #65; error.hint names the tool and object): XAE compiles before a login by itself, but that compile is not checked.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name (FrameworkUnitTest) or tree path (TIPC^FrameworkUnitTest^FrameworkUnitTest Project). Required when the solution has more than one PLC project.

LoginMode.description: Regular (default): PLC_LOGIN_FLAGS_REGULAR - login, download only when the runtime has no program (XAE decides). Download: FORCEDOWNLOAD (used by Send-TcPlcProgram); measured 2026-10-28 (4026 VS2022, UmRT): with code unchanged since the running program XAE does not download (data.downloaded = $false, _AppInfo.AppTimestamp unchanged); after a code change it downloads and the PLC is left in Stop. OnlineChange: FORCEONLINECHANGE. SILENT (256) is only OR-ed in with -SilentFlag.

SilentFlag.description: OR PLC_LOGIN_FLAGS_SILENT (256) into the login flags. Off by default: prompts are answered by the global ITcAutomationSettings.SilentMode that Connect-TcIde enables.

TimeoutSec.description: Expected upper bound of the Login COM call (Invoke-TcComRetry -TimeoutSec), default 300. Enable-TcConfig passes the rest of its overall -TimeoutSec budget.

tools.name: PlcLogout
tools.description: Log out of the PLC project (the runtime keeps running). With several PLC projects pass PlcProjectPath (PLC name or tree path); without it PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS. data.plcProjectPath / data.adsPort tell which PLC was logged out.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name (FrameworkUnitTest) or tree path (TIPC^FrameworkUnitTest^FrameworkUnitTest Project). Required when the solution has more than one PLC project.

tools.name: ProduceXml
tools.description: Generic tree tool, read-only: return the XML description of one tree item (ITcSmTreeItem.ProduceXml, TE1000 v1.7.0 5.2.1.8; root element TreeItem) in data.xml. Use its element paths to build a ConsumeXml fragment (e.g. TreeItem/TaskDef/CycleTime of a task). Missing path: TREEITEM_NOT_FOUND with the nearest existing parent in error.hint.

Path.description: Full tree path, e.g. "TIRT^PlcTask". No wildcards.

Recursive.description: Passed as bRecursive to ProduceXml (default false). The manual excerpt (5.2.1.8) does not say what it adds. Measured 2026-10-30 (registered tcauto, 4026 VS2022 XAE 3.1.4026.22): no difference on TIRT, a Task (TIRT^PlcTask) and a PLC folder with 3 children; other node types (I/O, NC) not measured.

tools.name: ReadVariable
tools.description: Read one or more PLC variables by symbol path (e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter","GVL.bRun"]) via ADS. Path is always an array, even for a single variable. One path: data is the entry (an unknown symbol fails with SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND); several paths: data is an array with one entry per path, a path that could not be read is {path, error, code, hint} inside it, so check every entry. Each entry has path, value, type: BOOL/integers/REAL/STRING are plain values; TIME/TOD, LTIME/LTOD, DATE/DT, LDATE/LDT return the IEC literal in value ("T#6s", "DT#2026-10-20-12:30:00") plus the raw integer in ms (TIME/TOD), ns (LTIME/LTOD/LDATE/LDT) or unix (DATE/DT); enums return the integer in value plus the member name in name; STRUCT/ARRAY return the raw bytes in value plus size. Requires ConnectAds (auto-reconnects after EnableConfig).

Path.description: Array of PLC symbol paths, e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter"]. Always an array, also for a single variable.

tools.name: RemoveReference
tools.description: Removes a library reference or placeholder from the PLC project (ITcPlcLibraryManager.RemoveReference). Dry-run by default; backs up the .plcproj and reads back.

Name.description: Library or placeholder name, with or without the leading '#' (e.g. Tc2_Math or #Tc2_Math).

Kind.description: Library or Placeholder: which reference -Name means. Optional; needed only when a library and a placeholder share the name (Placeholder; Library is refused then, see above).

DryRun.description: Default true: only report what would be removed. false: back up, remove, read back.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

tools.name: RemoveVariableLink
tools.description: Removes the link between a PLC variable and an I/O variable (ITcSysManager.UnlinkVariables) and reads the mapping back.

PlcVariable.description: Full tree path of the PLC variable, e.g. "TIPC^MyPlc^MyPlc Instance^PlcTask Inputs^MAIN.bIn".

IoChannel.description: Full tree path of the I/O variable. Omit to remove all links of -PlcVariable.

tools.name: ResetSolution
tools.description: Reload every project file from disk: dismisses the reload prompt if it is up (data.dismissedReloadPrompt). The XAE project prompt "The project file ... has been modified outside of TwinCAT XAE. Do you want to reload the project?" (a rewritten .plcproj; GetIdeModalDialog kind reload-prompt, reloadTarget project) is answered Yes by dialog control id (any UI language) and XAE reloads the project itself: then only ConnectIde runs again, no close / reopen (data.answeredYes=true, data.reopenedSolution=false, data.reloadTarget). Otherwise it closes all documents without saving (data.closedDocuments), Solution.Close, Solution.Open of the same .sln on the same IDE, then ConnectIde again (20-25 s in total, data.totalSec). Use right after .TcPOU / .plcproj files were changed ON DISK by another tool while they are open in an XAE editor: otherwise XAE shows the modal "File has been changed outside the environment. Reload the new file?" (GetIdeModalDialog kind reload-prompt) and every call blocks. A file that is not open in an editor is picked up automatically within ~5 s and needs no call; WritePouCode / AddPou write through COM and never need it. Before closing, the PLC objects in XAE are compared with the .plcproj on disk (data.projectCheck, per PLC: checked, missingOnDisk [file, relativePath, fileExists], extraOnDisk, complete; a PLC whose .plcproj cannot be located, e.g. an independent .xti project file, gets checked=false + reason and is skipped). Nothing is saved by default: an object that XAE has and the .plcproj does not list cannot be told apart from one deleted on disk, so any missingOnDisk returns PROJECT_UNSAVED_CHANGES and nothing is saved or closed (extraOnDisk alone does not block: the reopen loads the disk version, XAE loses nothing). SaveProjectChanges=true keeps the XAE version: ONLY the project files are saved (.tsproj / .plcproj, DTE Project.Save with a deadline, PROJECT_SAVE_TIMEOUT) and read back (data.savedProjects); it is still refused (PROJECT_UNSAVED_CHANGES, data.saveRefused, plc '*' = not one PLC) when a reload prompt was handled first, the .TcPOU / .TcDUT / .TcGVL is missing at its relative path on disk, or any PLC of the same .tsproj (Project.Save writes every .plcproj below it) could not be compared, was compared incompletely or lists objects XAE does not have. DiscardProjectChanges=true keeps the disk version (closes anyway, XAE-only objects are dropped). The two exclude each other (INVALID_PARAMS). Do not use BuildProject to resolve it: a build also saves editor buffers. What else Project.Save writes (measured 2026-10-28, 4026 VS2022): a dirty plain text document is NOT saved; whether unsaved content of a PLC editor (a POU edited in the GUI) is written was NOT verified. Unsaved library references / tasks / I/O are not detected. Any other modal dialog is reported as IDE_MODAL_DIALOG. The ADS connection is kept. BUILD_REQUIRED (#65): a reload from disk (the files may have been changed outside the module) records kind code-changed for the open solution (data.buildRequired names the tool and the .sln; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written): EnableConfig / PlcLogin / SendPlcProgram then refuse with BUILD_REQUIRED until BuildProject returns data.completeBuild=true.

SolutionPath.description: .sln to reopen. Default: the solution ConnectIde / OpenProject opened.

TimeoutSec.description: Expected upper bound for each of Documents.CloseAll, Solution.Close and Solution.Open in seconds (default 120).

DiscardProjectChanges.description: true = keep the disk version: skip the project file check and close without saving even when PLC objects in XAE are missing from the .plcproj on disk (they are dropped). Use after PROJECT_UNSAVED_CHANGES when the disk version is the one to keep. Not together with SaveProjectChanges.

SaveProjectChanges.description: true = keep the XAE version: objects in XAE that the .plcproj on disk does not list are saved (project files only) before closing. Refused (PROJECT_UNSAVED_CHANGES, data.saveRefused) when the disk shows a change: a reload prompt was handled, an object file is missing on disk, or any PLC of the same .tsproj (Project.Save writes all of them) could not be compared, was compared incompletely or its .plcproj lists objects XAE does not have. Not together with DiscardProjectChanges.

tools.name: RunTest
tools.description: Execute one test case created with NewTestCase (setup writes -> wait -> assertions -> teardown writes) against the connected PLC. Requires ConnectAds.

TestCase.description: A test case object as returned by NewTestCase.

tools.name: RunTestCycle
tools.description: Builds, activates (TwinCAT restart) and runs the PLC: changes the running machine. Confirm with the user first. Full automated test cycle: build (unless SkipBuild), activate configuration, login, run every test case from NewTestCase, then stop the PLC (unless KeepRunning). Returns per-test results. Can take many minutes (timeout 900 s). A test case that waits with the deprecated WaitMs has data.warning in its result; the report lists them in data.warnings. RUNTIME_CRASHED during activation is returned as it is (data.runtimeCrash).

TestCases.description: Array of test case objects as returned by NewTestCase.

SkipBuild.description: Skip the build step (if already built).

KeepRunning.description: Don't stop the PLC after tests complete.

tools.name: SaveArchive
tools.description: Saves the open solution (.tnzip) or the TwinCAT configuration (.tszip) as an archive of the state in XAE memory; checks the Error List, because a missing component is only reported there. Lists the archive entries.

FilePath.description: Absolute path of the archive to write: .tnzip for -Kind Solution, .tszip for -Kind Configuration.

Kind.description: Solution (default): the whole solution, .tnzip (ITcArchivePersist). Configuration: the TwinCAT project only, .tszip (ITcSysManager9.SaveAsArchive).

Overwrite.description: Replace an existing file: it is renamed to '<FilePath>.bak' first and put back when saving fails.

tools.name: SaveAsLibrary
tools.description: Saves the PLC project as a library file (.library / .compiled-library) with SaveAsLibrary(path, $false): the library is NOT installed. Also SAVES the .plcproj: unsaved XAE changes of the PLC project are written to disk (measured 2026-10-31, 4026 VS2022 and 4024 XAE, registered tcauto). Reads the file back.

FilePath.description: Absolute path of the library file to write, ending in .library or .compiled-library.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

Overwrite.description: Replace an existing file: it is renamed to '<FilePath>.bak' first and put back when saving fails.

tools.name: SendPlcProgram
tools.description: Download the compiled PLC program to the target (alias of PlcLogin LoginMode=Download: Login+Download without dialogs). Refused with BUILD_REQUIRED like PlcLogin. When the code is unchanged since the running program XAE skips the download: data.downloaded=false (measured 2026-10-28, _AppInfo.AppTimestamp unchanged). After a real download the PLC is left in Stop (data.plcStateAfter): SetPlcState State=Run to start it.

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path to PLC project. Default auto-detects from TIPC.

tools.name: SetPlcState
tools.description: Switch the PLC runtime to Run, Stop or Reset and wait for the state. WARNING: on a UmRT (user-mode runtime) target, Reset kills TcSystemServiceUm and you must EnableConfig again. Prefer Run/Stop.

State.description: Run, Stop or Reset. Reset kills TcSystemServiceUm on a UmRT target.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum wait for Run/Stop to be reached. Default 30.

tools.name: SetSystemState
tools.description: Switch TwinCAT to Run or Config via ADS WriteControl (no StartRestartTwinCAT dialog) and poll until the state is reached. Switching to Config stops the runtime: all outputs go to zero. Does not download the PLC program; EnableConfig Force=true is the usual choice. Run sends AdsState Reset (2) and Config sends Reconfig (16) on port 10000 (data.sentAdsState; Run (5) is refused there with ADS 0x701). After the target state is seen it must hold for SettleSec (default 3 s) and is read back (data.readbackState, data.stateTrace): a runtime that falls back to Config (e.g. ADS 1809 symbol version invalid) returns SYSTEM_STATE_MISMATCH, never success. When the original state equals the target (Run -> Run restart) the system must first be seen leaving it. data: originalState, finalState, reached, held, leftOriginal, latencyMs; when it stays in / falls back to Config the license server (ADS port 30) is read and expired / invalid licenses are put into error.hint and data.licenses. Local UmRT only: when its TcSystemServiceUm process (data.servicePidAtStart) disappears and port 10000 answers ADS 0x7 for 10 s, RUNTIME_CRASHED is returned at once (data.lastError, lastState, runtimeName, unreachableMs) instead of SYSTEM_STATE_TIMEOUT after TimeoutSec; restart the UmRT, then EnableConfig Force=true.

AmsNetId.description: Target AMS Net ID. Optional; resolved from the IDE target, then the ADS session. Never falls back to the local system 127.0.0.1.1.1.

TimeoutSec.description: Maximum time to wait for the target state. Default 60.

SettleSec.description: Seconds the reached state must hold before success (sampled every 250 ms, then read back). Default 3; 0 = final readback only.

tools.name: SetTarget
tools.description: Set the target AmsNetId (ITcSysManager.SetTargetNetId, always done first: data.amsNetId, data.targetSet=true even when the result is an error) and make the active solution platform follow the target. The target decides the platform: the active solution platform must match it (Usermode Runtime / UmRT and TwinCAT/BSD = 'TwinCAT OS (x64)', Windows RT target = 'TwinCAT RT (x64)'), otherwise EnableConfig fails with ACTIVATE_FAILED. Before switching, the project platform of the .tsproj under the chosen solution platform is checked: a solution platform that maps to another project platform (e.g. 'TwinCAT OS (x64)' -> 'TwinCAT OS (ARMT2)') returns PLATFORM_PROJECT_MISMATCH and nothing is switched (data.platformMap). With Platform that platform is activated for Configuration (default Release; data.platformCheck='parameter'). Without Platform the platform the target reports through TARGETINFO (ADS port 200, IG 0x700) is activated ('target'); not in the solution -> PLATFORM_NOT_FOUND. Target without TARGETINFO (ADS 0x702, data.adsError) and no Platform -> PLATFORM_UNKNOWN (NetId already set; nothing guessed). NoPlatformSwitch=true only sets the NetId ('disabled'). Returns data.platform (solution platform) / projectPlatform (active .tsproj) / requestedProjectPlatform / platformChanged / targetPlatform / targetPlatformSource and, when a platform was activated, configuration / previousPlatform / availablePlatforms / projectCheck / platformMap.

AmsNetId.description: Target AMS Net ID (e.g., "127.0.0.1.1.1" for local).

Platform.description: Solution platform to activate, e.g. 'TwinCAT OS (x64)' (Usermode Runtime / UmRT, TwinCAT/BSD) or 'TwinCAT RT (x64)' (Windows RT). Omit to follow the platform the target reports (TARGETINFO); a target without TARGETINFO then returns PLATFORM_UNKNOWN.

Configuration.description: Solution configuration name. With Platform default Release; for the automatic switch the active configuration.

NoPlatformSwitch.description: true = only set the target NetId; never touch the solution platform and never return PLATFORM_UNKNOWN.

tools.name: SetVariableLink
tools.description: Links a PLC variable to an I/O variable (ITcSysManager.LinkVariables) and reads the mapping back.

PlcVariable.description: Full tree path of the PLC variable, e.g. "TIPC^MyPlc^MyPlc Instance^PlcTask Inputs^MAIN.bIn".

IoChannel.description: Full tree path of the I/O variable, e.g. "TIID^EtherCAT Master^Term 1 (EK1100)^Term 2 (EL1004)^Channel 1^Input".

tools.name: UninstallLibrary
tools.description: Removes one library version from a library repository of this machine (ITcPlcLibraryManager.UninstallLibrary). Dry-run by default; exact name / version / distributor; backs up the version folder; reads back with ScanLibraries.

LibraryName.description: Library name exactly as ScanLibraries lists it (Get-TcLibraries -Repository), e.g. Tc2_Math.

Distributor.description: Exact distributor, e.g. Beckhoff Automation GmbH.

DryRun.description: Default true: only check and report. false: uninstall and read back.

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (the Library Manager lives on its References node).

tools.name: UnlinkProgramFromTask
tools.description: Removes a program call from a PLC task (DeleteChild of the 650 child of '<Plc> Project^<PlcTask>'). Dry-run by default; backs up the task's .TcTTO and the call (ExportChild .zip) first and reads back.

ProgramName.description: Name of the program call to remove, exactly as listed below the task.

PlcTask.description: Name of the PLC task below '<Plc> Project' (default PlcTask).

PlcProjectPath.description: PLC name or tree path ('TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project') when the solution has more than one PLC project (otherwise PLC_PROJECT_AMBIGUOUS).

DryRun.description: Default true: only report what would be removed. false: back up, remove, read back.

tools.name: WatchVariable
tools.description: Poll one or more PLC variables (Path is an array; every round reads each path in order) every IntervalMs. Without Until it samples for DurationMs (default 2000). With Until it waits for a condition '<Path> <op> <value>' (op: == != > < >= <=, e.g. 'MAIN.fTarget == 123.5' or 'MAIN.bDone == TRUE'; <Path> must be one of Path) and returns as soon as it holds or after UntilTimeoutMs (default 5000): data.untilMet, untilSample, elapsedMs. Numbers compare numerically, TRUE/FALSE as booleans, other values as case-insensitive text; a failed read never satisfies the condition. Only the last KeepLast samples are returned (default 20 with Until, 50 without); sampleCount is the total and truncated tells whether older samples were dropped. Single-path samples are {timestamp, value} plus ms/ns/unix for TIME/DATE types and name for enums (same conversion as ReadVariable; a numeric Until value compares with that raw integer, text with the IEC literal / enum member name), multi-path samples {timestamp, values:{<path>:<value>}}. Use Until instead of a long DurationMs or repeated ReadVariable calls. Requires ConnectAds.

Path.description: One or more variable paths to monitor, e.g. ["MAIN.nCounter"] or ["MAIN.fActual","MAIN.bDone"]. Always an array.

IntervalMs.description: Delay between sampling rounds in milliseconds. Default: 100.

DurationMs.description: Sampling duration in ms when Until is not given (default 2000).

Until.description: Stop condition '<Path> <op> <value>' with op one of == != > < >= <=, e.g. 'MAIN.fTarget == 123.5'. <Path> must be in Path (case-insensitive).

UntilTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time in ms to wait for Until before returning untilMet=false. Default 5000.

TimeoutMs.description: Legacy alias of UntilTimeoutMs; used only when UntilTimeoutMs is not given.

KeepLast.description: Number of most recent samples to return. 0 = auto (20 with Until, 50 without). sampleCount still counts every round; truncated=true when older samples were dropped.

tools.name: WritePouCode
tools.description: Write Declaration and/or Implementation of an existing PLC object through the XAE edit buffer (no ResetSolution needed). DUT / GVL / ITF / property have only a declaration: passing Implementation for one of them returns INVALID_PARAMS and nothing is written (data.objectKind; for a property the hint points to its ^Get / ^Set accessor); send the whole TYPE ... END_TYPE / VAR_GLOBAL ... END_VAR as Declaration. An action has only an implementation: Declaration on it -> INVALID_PARAMS. Implementation "" clears the body (written as ' and read back empty, data.cleared=true; otherwise POU_WRITE_FAILED reason empty-not-applied); Declaration "" -> POU_WRITE_FAILED reason empty-not-supported, nothing written. Members and POU_AMBIGUOUS / POU_MEMBER_UNSUPPORTED (ITF property Get / Set) as for GetPouCode. data: pouPath, resolvedBy, objectKind, updated[], cleared. Run BuildProject afterwards to compile. BUILD_REQUIRED (#65): a write records kind code-changed (also a write that failed after a setter was called: the edit buffer may have changed; a request refused before any setter records nothing). An ItemType that cannot be read -> POU_WRITE_FAILED reason itemtype-unreadable, nothing written for the open solution (data.buildRequired names the tool and the object; data.stateWarning when the state file could not be written): EnableConfig / PlcLogin / SendPlcProgram then refuse with BUILD_REQUIRED until BuildProject returns data.completeBuild=true.

PouName.description: Name of the POU to write to. A member can be named Parent.Member: FB_X.M_Run, FB_X.P_Value.Get (tried only after the name as given found nothing).

Declaration.description: Structured Text declaration section (VAR blocks). An empty / blank -Declaration is refused (POU_WRITE_FAILED, data.reason empty-not-supported): clearing a declaration is not measured.

Implementation.description: Structured Text implementation section (code body). -Implementation '' clears the body: ImplementationText = '' is written and must read back empty (measured 2026-10-31, 4026 VS2022, self-built client: COM ImplementationText = '' on a method reads back '').

PouPath.description: Full tree path; omit to auto-detect from PouName (POUs folder -> project root -> tree search depth 4 -> Parent.Member, see data.pouPath / data.resolvedBy). Format on 4024 and 4026: TIPC^<Plc>^<Plc> Project^POUs^<name>; DUT ...^DUTs^<name>, GVL ...^GVLs^<name>; member ...^<POU>^<member>, accessor ...^<POU>^<property>^Get. Use GetProjectTree with PlcOnly=true to list paths.

tools.name: WriteVariable
tools.description: Write a single PLC variable by symbol path via ADS. Writes directly into the running PLC; may drive outputs or axes. Confirm with the user first. Value is converted to the PLC type of the symbol: JSON bool for BOOL, number for integer/REAL types, string for STRING; TIME/TOD take an IEC literal ("T#6s", "T#1m30s500ms", "TOD#12:30:00"; integer ms also accepted), LTIME/LTOD "LTIME#1us" (or integer ns), DATE/DT "D#2026-10-20" / "DT#2026-10-20-12:30:00" / ISO 8601 (or integer seconds since 1970), enums an integer or the member name. STRUCT/ARRAY cannot be written as a whole (TYPE_MISMATCH): write their members. data.written is the value actually written: the normalized literal for time types ("T#6000ms" -> "T#6s", raw integer in ms/ns/unix), the converted number otherwise, plus name for enums. Requires ConnectAds.

Value.description: New value matching the PLC type of the symbol: JSON bool (BOOL), number (integer/REAL/LREAL), string (STRING). TIME/TOD: "T#6s" / "T#1m30s500ms" / "TOD#12:30:00" (integer ms also accepted); LTIME/LTOD: "LTIME#1us" (or integer ns); DATE/DT: "D#2026-10-20", "DT#2026-10-20-12:30:00" or ISO 8601 (or integer seconds since 1970); LDATE/LDT: "LDT#..." (or integer ns); enum: integer or member name ("READY").
